transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I'm here because... I've just been living with this constant mix of guilt, fear, and anger ever since my friend was killed. Everyone seemed to think it would ease up over time, but it just hasn't eased the way they said it would.
Since your friend's death, have you had unwanted memories, thoughts, or flashbacks about what happened?

Yes, I do. It doesn't even take much to bring it on. Sometimes it's just a crosswalk signal beeping, or hearing the loud growl of a truck going by. Even just seeing a walking-tour map can do it. 

When that happens, it suddenly puts the whole scene right back in my head. It's so sharp... I can just see my friend stepping off the curb again, and I can't stop the memory from playing out.
Have you found yourself avoiding certain places, people, or activities because they remind you of your friend or the accident?

Yes, I do. I go completely out of my way to avoid that intersection now. I just can't go near it. And I've actually stopped signing up for most tours, or even local safety meetings. I just... I cannot bear it when the conversations circle back to what happened there.
